---- MODULE GermanData ----
EXTENDS GermanDataDefs

\* BEGIN AGENT HELPERS
LOCAL AgTps == INSTANCE TLAPS

AgDataOpt == DATA \cup {NoData}

AgTypeInv ==
    /\ cache  \in [NODE -> [state : {"I","S","E"},               data : AgDataOpt]]
    /\ chan1  \in [NODE -> [cmd : {"Empty","ReqS","ReqE"},       data : AgDataOpt]]
    /\ chan2  \in [NODE -> [cmd : {"Empty","Inv","GntS","GntE"}, data : AgDataOpt]]
    /\ chan3  \in [NODE -> [cmd : {"Empty","InvAck"},            data : AgDataOpt]]
    /\ invSet \in SUBSET NODE
    /\ shrSet \in SUBSET NODE
    /\ exGntd \in BOOLEAN
    /\ curCmd \in {"Empty","ReqS","ReqE"}
    /\ curPtr \in NODE \cup {NoNode}
    /\ memData \in DATA
    /\ auxData \in DATA

AgCtrlInv ==
    /\ ((curCmd = "Empty") <=> (curPtr = NoNode))
    /\ invSet \subseteq shrSet
    /\ \A i \in NODE :
         /\ (cache[i].state \in {"S","E"} => i \in shrSet)
         /\ (chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS","GntE","Inv"} => i \in shrSet)
         /\ (chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => i \in shrSet)
         /\ (chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => cache[i].state = "I")
         /\ (chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => chan2[i].cmd = "Empty")
         /\ (chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" => i \notin invSet)
         /\ (chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" => i \notin invSet)
         /\ ((chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" \/ chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck") => curCmd # "Empty")
         /\ ((chan2[i].cmd = "Inv" \/ chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck")
               => (curCmd = "ReqE" \/ exGntd = TRUE))
         /\ (chan2[i].cmd = "GntS" => exGntd = FALSE)
         /\ (chan2[i].cmd = "GntE" => exGntd = TRUE)
         /\ (chan2[i].cmd = "GntE" => cache[i].state = "I")
         /\ (chan2[i].cmd = "GntE" => chan3[i].cmd = "Empty")
         /\ (cache[i].state = "E" => exGntd = TRUE)
    /\ (exGntd = TRUE =>
          \A i \in NODE, j \in NODE : (i \in shrSet /\ j \in shrSet) => i = j)
    /\ (exGntd = TRUE =>
          \A i \in NODE : i \in shrSet =>
             \/ chan2[i].cmd = "GntE"
             \/ cache[i].state = "E"
             \/ chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck")

AgDataInv ==
    /\ (exGntd = FALSE => memData = auxData)
    /\ \A i \in NODE :
         /\ (cache[i].state # "I" => cache[i].data = auxData)
         /\ (chan2[i].cmd \in {"GntS","GntE"} => chan2[i].data = auxData)
         /\ ((chan3[i].cmd = "InvAck" /\ exGntd = TRUE) => chan3[i].data = auxData)

AgIndInv == AgTypeInv /\ AgCtrlInv /\ AgDataInv

LEMMA AgInitInv == Init => AgIndInv
BY NoNodeNotInNODE, AgTps!SMTT("r30")
   DEF Init, AgIndInv, AgTypeInv, AgCtrlInv, AgDataInv, AgDataOpt

LEMMA AgStepInv == AgIndInv /\ [Next]_vars => AgIndInv'
<1> USE NoNodeNotInNODE, NoDataNotInDATA
     DEF AgIndInv, AgTypeInv, AgCtrlInv, AgDataInv, AgDataOpt
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME AgIndInv, [Next]_vars PROVE AgIndInv' OBVIOUS
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  BY <1>1, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF vars
<1>2. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, NEW d \in DATA, Store(i, d) PROVE AgIndInv'
  BY <1>2, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF Store
<1>3. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, SendReq(i) PROVE AgIndInv'
  BY <1>3, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF SendReq
<1>4. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, RecvReq(i) PROVE AgIndInv'
  BY <1>4, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF RecvReq
<1>5. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, SendInv(i) PROVE AgIndInv'
  BY <1>5, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF SendInv
<1>6. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, SendInvAck(i) PROVE AgIndInv'
  BY <1>6, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF SendInvAck
<1>7. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, RecvInvAck(i) PROVE AgIndInv'
  BY <1>7, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF RecvInvAck
<1>8. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, SendGnt(i) PROVE AgIndInv'
  BY <1>8, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF SendGnt
<1>9. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, RecvGnt(i) PROVE AgIndInv'
  BY <1>9, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF RecvGnt
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9 DEF Next

LEMMA AgInvariance == Spec => []AgIndInv
<1>1. Init => AgIndInv BY AgInitInv
<1>2. AgIndInv /\ [Next]_vars => AgIndInv' BY AgStepInv
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AgTps!PTL DEF Spec

LEMMA AgInvDataProp == AgIndInv => DataProp
BY AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF AgIndInv, AgDataInv, DataProp

LEMMA AgInvTransactionConsistency == AgIndInv => TransactionConsistency
BY AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF AgIndInv, AgCtrlInv, TransactionConsistency

LEMMA AgInvDirectoryAccurate == AgIndInv => DirectoryAccurate
BY AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF AgIndInv, AgCtrlInv, DirectoryAccurate

LEMMA AgInvExclusiveIsolation == AgIndInv => ExclusiveIsolation
BY AgTps!SMTT("r30")
   DEF AgIndInv, AgTypeInv, AgCtrlInv, AgDataOpt, ExclusiveIsolation

LEMMA AgInvWritebackCarriesLatest == AgIndInv => WritebackCarriesLatest
BY AgTps!SMTT("r30")
   DEF AgIndInv, AgTypeInv, AgCtrlInv, AgDataInv, AgDataOpt,
       WritebackCarriesLatest

LEMMA AgRefineInit == Init => Abstract!Init
BY AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF Init, Abstract!Init

LEMMA AgRefineStep == AgIndInv /\ [Next]_vars => [Abstract!Next]_Abstract!vars
<1> USE DEF AgIndInv, AgTypeInv, AgCtrlInv, AgDataInv, AgDataOpt
<1> SUFFICES ASSUME AgIndInv, [Next]_vars
             PROVE  [Abstract!Next]_Abstract!vars
    OBVIOUS
<1>1. CASE UNCHANGED vars
  BY <1>1, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF vars, Abstract!vars
<1>2. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, NEW d \in DATA, Store(i, d)
      PROVE  UNCHANGED Abstract!vars
  BY <1>2, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF Store, Abstract!vars
<1>3. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, SendReq(i) PROVE Abstract!SendReq(i)
  BY <1>3, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF SendReq, Abstract!SendReq
<1>4. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, RecvReq(i) PROVE Abstract!RecvReq(i)
  BY <1>4, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF RecvReq, Abstract!RecvReq
<1>5. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, SendInv(i) PROVE Abstract!SendInv(i)
  BY <1>5, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF SendInv, Abstract!SendInv
<1>6. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, SendInvAck(i) PROVE Abstract!SendInvAck(i)
  BY <1>6, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF SendInvAck, Abstract!SendInvAck
<1>7. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, RecvInvAck(i) PROVE Abstract!RecvInvAck(i)
  BY <1>7, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF RecvInvAck, Abstract!RecvInvAck
<1>8. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, SendGnt(i) PROVE Abstract!SendGnt(i)
  BY <1>8, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF SendGnt, Abstract!SendGnt
<1>9. ASSUME NEW i \in NODE, RecvGnt(i) PROVE Abstract!RecvGnt(i)
  BY <1>9, AgTps!SMTT("r30") DEF RecvGnt, Abstract!RecvGnt
<1> QED
  BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, <1>4, <1>5, <1>6, <1>7, <1>8, <1>9
     DEF Next, Abstract!Next
\* END AGENT HELPERS

THEOREM Spec => []DataProp
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_DataProp.tla
<1>1. Spec => []AgIndInv BY AgInvariance
<1>2. AgIndInv => DataProp BY AgInvDataProp
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AgTps!PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_DataProp.tla

THEOREM Spec => []TransactionConsistency
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_TransactionConsistency.tla
<1>1. Spec => []AgIndInv BY AgInvariance
<1>2. AgIndInv => TransactionConsistency BY AgInvTransactionConsistency
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AgTps!PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_TransactionConsistency.tla

THEOREM Spec => []DirectoryAccurate
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_DirectoryAccurate.tla
<1>1. Spec => []AgIndInv BY AgInvariance
<1>2. AgIndInv => DirectoryAccurate BY AgInvDirectoryAccurate
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AgTps!PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_DirectoryAccurate.tla

THEOREM Spec => []ExclusiveIsolation
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_ExclusiveIsolation.tla
<1>1. Spec => []AgIndInv BY AgInvariance
<1>2. AgIndInv => ExclusiveIsolation BY AgInvExclusiveIsolation
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AgTps!PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_ExclusiveIsolation.tla

THEOREM Spec => []WritebackCarriesLatest
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_WritebackCarriesLatest.tla
<1>1. Spec => []AgIndInv BY AgInvariance
<1>2. AgIndInv => WritebackCarriesLatest BY AgInvWritebackCarriesLatest
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, AgTps!PTL
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_WritebackCarriesLatest.tla

THEOREM Spec => Refinement
\* BEGIN AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_Refinement.tla
<1>1. Spec => []AgIndInv BY AgInvariance
<1>2. Init => Abstract!Init BY AgRefineInit
<1>3. AgIndInv /\ [Next]_vars => [Abstract!Next]_Abstract!vars BY AgRefineStep
<1> QED BY <1>1, <1>2, <1>3, AgTps!PTL DEF Spec, Refinement, Abstract!Spec
\* END AGENT PROOF tlaplus_examples_GermanProtocol/GermanData_Refinement.tla
====
